## Publish gate report

**Going out:** Paid creator post, UK audience. The platform and send time weren't given.

**Checks**
- **Claims:** Passes. "Packed by hand in Bristol" is on the policy list ("every tin is packed by hand in Bristol"). The Assam is a product fact, which is fine as written. There are no stats, rankings, guarantees, testimonials or comparisons.
- **Regulated claims:** Passes. "Afternoon reset" and "ten minutes away from my phone" are lifestyle phrasing, with no health, wellbeing or mood-effect claim. There are no prices, offers, environmental or children's claims.
- **House style:** Passes. The copy is plain, specific and in a first-person creator voice. It has no stock openers, slogan closers or banned words. The policy has no voice section, so I checked against general AI tells only.
- **Disclosure:** Passes. "Ad |" is the first thing in the post, in plain words, before the reader engages. For UK rules this is what's needed.

**Fixed:** Nothing. No changes were needed.

**Needs a decision:**
- Use the platform's own paid-partnership or branded-content tool as well as the "Ad |" label, if the channel has one. I can't verify this from the draft.
- Confirm the creator's contract covers this wording and that they've seen the final text.

**Approver:** The policy names no approver, so a named person on your side needs to give an explicit yes to this exact text. Nothing has been approved or recorded yet. After approval, run `approve.py --by "Their Name" --what "..."` and retry the publish.
